steps.title: Project Initialization
steps.description: Configure build script parameters, namespace definitions, target compile SDK versions, and base configuration templates.

steps.title: Configure Manifest and System Properties
steps.description: Create high-performance AndroidManifest.xml definitions containing application launchers, custom standard Material theme integrations, and safe permission definitions.

steps.title: Create Local Storage Framework
steps.description: Implement local database handler schemas via SQLiteOpenHelper to store student subjects, tasks, priorities, due dates, timer details, and reminders securely.

steps.title: Formulate Main UI View Architecture
steps.description: Create custom layout structures containing interactive study timers, progress statistics, list containers, detail templates, and navigation bars.

steps.title: Implement Navigation View Controllers
steps.description: Program custom layout switches for the dynamic tab layout to switch seamlessly between Subjects, Tasks, Timer, and Progress views.

steps.title: Integrate Subject Management Systems
steps.description: Add functional routines to register new fields of study, list current registered courses, and delete unwanted subject fields along with their dependencies.

steps.title: Integrate Task Allocation Mechanics
steps.description: Design interactive inputs for assignment titles, subject spinners, date selection calendars, and priority level managers.

steps.title: Program Dynamic Pomodoro Study Clock
steps.description: Engineer active countdown state machines configured to manage continuous concentration loops with custom alerts and complete resume/pause features.

steps.title: Build Quick Study Reminders Manager
steps.description: Implement simple reminder list with clock settings to keep continuous revision tracks.

steps.title: Establish Real-Time Progress Visualizers
steps.description: Program statistical formulas that evaluate current completeness scores per subject alongside generalized work-item calculations.

steps.title: Building Student Study Planner
steps.description: Execute Gradle compilation process, verify package assembly, optimize dependencies, and prepare the final executable package.
